boundary_conditions: dT_dx(0) = -(outer_heat_transfer_coefficient*(T_air - T(0)) + wall_solar_absorptance*(1 - shading_fraction)*solar_irradiance + lamella_radiative_coefficient*lamella_solar_absorptance*shading_fraction*solar_irradiance/(2*lamella_convective_coefficient) - wall_emittance*net_longwave_sky_loss*(1 - shading_fraction))/wall_conductance

parameters.name: wall_conductance
parameters.justification: Conductance of wall/roof layers plus inner film, 1/(1/U - 1/h_o) for U=0.5 W/m2K and h_o=20 W/m2K; x normalised over the wall thickness.

parameters.name: T_air
parameters.justification: Daytime mean summer air temperature 38 C.

parameters.name: wall_solar_absorptance
parameters.justification: Wall behind the screen keeps a conventional aged cool paint.

parameters.name: solar_irradiance
parameters.justification: Daytime mean on a west wall.

parameters.name: outer_heat_transfer_coefficient
parameters.justification: Sheltered convection behind a screen, lower than the 20 W/m2K of an exposed wall.
